text: {"verdict": "approved", "governing_rule": "MP-IMG-001", "reason": "Member is eligible with active coverage, no waiting period applies, the imaging benefit category is not excluded, the provider is in-network and in good standing, and sufficient imaging benefit remains ($2,900 remaining vs. $1,450 cost). The diagnosis (M54.16) supports the requested MRI lumbar spine. Clinical documentation satisfies all elements of MP-IMG-001: (1) an 8-week trial of supervised physical therapy plus NSAID and muscle relaxant with documented lack of improvement; (2) objective exam findings including asymmetric diminished patellar reflex, L4 dermatomal sensory loss, 4/5 ankle dorsiflexion weakness, and positive straight leg raise; (3) recent plain radiographs (07/30/2026) showing disc space narrowing; and (4) a stated impact on management -- pending neurosurgical consultation to determine candidacy for surgical decompression.
